{{Top}}
'''Second Minister''' was a title that was given to the second-in-command of the [[Coruscant Ministry of Ingress/Legends|Coruscant Ministry of Ingress]]. When [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] became the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], he appointed [[Tannon Praji/Legends|Tannon Praji]] to be Second Minister of the Ministry.
